content.data: I have been working with Shopify since 2009, covering the platform evolution from classic theme development to modern Online Store 2.0 and headless initiatives.
My work combines technical depth and business focus: conversion-critical storefront experiences, maintainable architecture, and integration-ready foundations for growth.

data: Built and evolved scalable Shopify themes using maintainable Liquid patterns and reusable section-based structures.
Delivered conversion-focused features across PDP, cart, listing, and merchandising experiences.
Supported continuous release cycles with iterative fixes, quality hardening, and production stability.
Implemented storefront and backoffice integrations through Storefront/Admin APIs and webhook-driven workflows.
Connected Shopify experiences with analytics, subscription, and operational flows where required by the business.
Balanced implementation speed with long-term maintainability and data consistency.
Contributed to Hydrogen/headless initiatives in enterprise contexts when the business case justified added complexity.
Worked with modern frontend stacks while preserving Shopify-native strengths for hybrid architectures.
Focused on practical adoption paths instead of premature migration.

content.data: Across enterprise Shopify engagements, I have consistently worked on conversion-critical surfaces (PDP, cart, listing, navigation), balancing release speed with quality and maintainability.

content.data: Performance is handled as a continuous engineering practice embedded in delivery, QA, and post-release validation.
In enterprise Shopify environments, I prioritize real user experience on critical journeys (homepage, PDP, cart, navigation), balancing speed and stability.

data: LCP/CLS optimization through rendering strategy, asset prioritization, and template refactoring.
Image optimization with responsive sizing and modern formats where applicable.
Critical CSS prioritization, defer/async for non-critical assets, and reduced render-blocking paths.
Third-party script control to protect Core Web Vitals and interaction responsiveness.
Continuous validation with Lighthouse and field signals from Chrome UX Report.
Regression-oriented checks after releases to keep quality stable under fast delivery cycles.
Data-informed prioritization of improvements by effort vs user impact.
